# AeroVision

> AeroVision is a national-scale geospatial atmospheric analytics and AI forecasting platform for India, integrating Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) continuous ground telemetry, Sentinel-5P TROPOMI satellite formaldehyde (HCHO) observations, NASA FIRMS active fire detection, and ECMWF ERA5 planetary boundary layer physics.

## Analytical Dashboards

- [National AQI Overview](https://aerovision.in/#aqi): Real-time air quality index telemetry from over 500 CPCB continuous ambient air quality monitoring stations (CAAQMS) with 7-day trend modeling.
- [Pollutant Concentration Cartography](https://aerovision.in/#pollutants): Geospatial distribution maps for particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10) and criteria gases (NO2, SO2, CO, Ozone).
- [Sentinel-5P HCHO Hotspots](https://aerovision.in/#hcho): Multispectral TROPOMI tropospheric formaldehyde column observations for petrochemical and biogenic VOC tracking.
- [NASA FIRMS Thermal Fire Correlation](https://aerovision.in/#fire): Near real-time satellite fire radiative power (FRP) correlated with smoke dispersion and stubble burning episodes.
- [Atmospheric Transport Dynamics](https://aerovision.in/#transport): Wind vector trajectories and planetary boundary layer dispersion modeling for transboundary pollution plumes.
- [ECMWF Weather & Planetary Boundary Layer](https://aerovision.in/#weather): Boundary layer height, temperature inversions, relative humidity, and surface wind fields.
- [AI Early Warning Insights](https://aerovision.in/#insights): Automated machine learning intelligence detecting anomalous particulate spikes and advisory conditions.
- [Research & Policy Reports](https://aerovision.in/#reports): Curated open-access reports on episodic air pollution events and satellite sensor validation over India.
- [Interactive 3D Pipeline Digital Twin](https://aerovision.in/#pipeline): Five-stage atmospheric processing pipeline simulation modeling telemetry ingestion, satellite observation, AI transport physics, cartography, and health advisories.

## Machine Readable Interfaces

- [OpenAPI Specification](https://aero-vision.onrender.com/openapi.json): Standard OpenAPI 3.1 REST API specification detailing real-time endpoints for stations, pollutants, hotspots, and predictions.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery Catalog](https://aerovision.in/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable ARD AI catalog enabling autonomous agents to discover AeroVision tools and capabilities.
- [XML Sitemap](https://aerovision.in/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive URL index of all national atmospheric analytical modules.

## Governance & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://aerovision.in/#privacy): Transparent data privacy declaration compliant with India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, GDPR, and CCPA.
- [Terms & Scientific Attribution](https://aerovision.in/#terms): Academic research terms, CC-BY-4.0 open data licensing, and data attribution protocols for ISRO SAC, CPCB, NASA, and Copernicus.
